title: What Engineering Teams Build with AI: CI Pipelines, Code Review Bots, and Dev Portals
summary: Engineering teams use Blink to build CI status dashboards, PR review bots, developer portals, and DORA metrics tools — internal apps that no off-the-shelf SaaS covers. Here's what they build and why.
body_markdown: 51% of developers use AI coding tools daily as of April 2026, and 78% of Fortune 500 companies run AI-assisted development in production. Internal tools — dashboards, bots, portals — are exactly where vibe coding delivers the most ROI. The stakes are lower than customer-facing products, the requirements are precise (engineers describe them well), and the value is immediate. Blink adds a layer of reliability by generating the full-stack app — not just the frontend — so the database schema and auth layer are production-grade from the start.
